_comment: Sangam runtime rules that override or qualify what Operaton 2.2 parses (R44 standards profile, R46). Each rule names its source. scripts/gen-compat.mjs merges these with the engine's parsed elements and the modeller palettes.

ScriptTask.note: Rejected at deploy; scripts run in the out-of-process script worker (D-46, R6, D-8).

BusinessRuleTask.note: Needs operaton:decisionRefBinding (deployment); a missing binding is rejected (D-12).

CallActivity.note: Without calledElementBinding the call binds to the deployment, not latest (D-12).

AdHocSubProcess.note: Rejected by Operaton (ENGINE-09005); Sangam port with start/complete API (FC-01).

ComplexGateway.note: Parsed but no runtime join semantics in either engine (D-52).

Transaction.note: Cancel end / boundary events with compensation.

DataStoreReference.note: Documentation only; data stores are not executed (D-52).

DataObjectReference.note: Documentation only; use process variables or R78 data objects.

Participant.note: Only the executable process of one pool is deployed; message flows between pools are not executed (D-52).

MultiInstanceLoopCharacteristics.note: Literal loopCardinality above multiInstanceMaxCardinality is rejected; a runtime guard checks collections (GP-09, D-23).

StandardLoopCharacteristics.note: Standard loop is not executed (D-52); use multi-instance or a gateway loop.

TimerEventDefinition.note: UTC due dates; sangam:catchUp FIRE_ONCE | FIRE_ALL | SKIP_MISSED; business calendar tag (R31, D-01, FC-23).

ConditionalEventDefinition.note: Also covers Flowable variable-listener events on import (FC-05).

MessageEventDefinition.note: Early messages are buffered by the Sangam inbox (D-33, R38); sangam:eventType links to the event registry (FC-02).

TerminateEventDefinition.note: Terminates the enclosing scope; terminateAll is a Stage E port (FC-22).

MultipleEventDefinition.note: Multiple / parallel-multiple events are not executed (D-52).

InputData.note: Requirement only; values come from variables.

KnowledgeSource.note: Documentation of authority (for example the delegation order).

BusinessKnowledgeModel.note: BKM invocation is not executed by Operaton's DMN engine; R8 DMN SPI at Stage D.

DecisionService.note: Decision services need the R8 DMN SPI (FC-53, Stage D).

HitPolicy.COLLECT.note: Including SUM, MIN, MAX, COUNT aggregations.

Context.note: Boxed context expressions are not executed.

FunctionDefinition.note: Boxed function definition is not executed.

LiteralExpression.note: FEEL (feel-scala) per the R33 type contract.

HumanTask.note: Completed tasks are audited as COMPLETED, not terminated (D-25).

ProcessTask.note: Exit or terminate cancels the called process (D-26); use it for service, HTTP and external work (FC-11, FC-58).

Sentry.note: Entry and exit criteria with if-part conditions.

TimerEventListener.note: Rejected at deploy: Operaton registers no handler, so it never fires (D-08); FC-55 at Stage E.

UserEventListener.note: Rejected at deploy (D-08); FC-55 at Stage E.

RepetitionRule.note: Condition-based repetition only; collections and max count are Stage E (FC-57).
